source_selection: The package build consumes upstream master or the explicit KIMI_TOMLPLUSPLUS_SOURCE checkout.
license_source: LICENSE from the exact checkout consumed by the package build is copied without modification.
incorporation: The adapter and helper link kimi_config.cpp, which parses configurations with toml++. The quota probe calls direct_quota_route in kimi_quota_direct.cpp, which uses toml++ to read provider settings.
